title: How to Play Numstep
body:
Draw a numbered walk through every white square.

Fill the grid with chains connecting the coloured clues. Every chain must start on a clue and count its steps correctly to get to the next clue. You cannot visit a suqare more than once, and you must never visit the black squares. Moves must be up-down-left-right, never diagonal. Every white square must be filled.
